necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks, corresponding to diagnosis codes R55 and G45.9. Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) was medically necessary to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias or hemodynamic instability contributing to these syncopal events and cerebral hypoperfusion. This diagnostic monitoring is critical for identifying the etiology of the patient's symptoms and guiding appropriate treatment.
